doc.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25

title: Jack Kelly, Doc Higgins and the South Memphis Jug Band
summary: Corley recalls Jack Kelly, Doc Higgins on jug and violinist Will Betts.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I see. Who were some of the outstanding people here that you remember? Either jug bands or guitar players or the insta horns or what have you?
Jack Kelly is one of them.

He played guitar. Doc Higgins. They had the South Memphis jug band. He blowed the jug. Great big fella. Called Doc Higgins. And let me see. Two or three other boys played guitar around here. But I just can't remember the name. They played with Jack Kelly. Will Betts. He played violin. And he's dead. Jack Kelly's dead.
